# `^BO` – Aztec Bar Code Parameters

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Print an Aztec barcode (alternate command) with configurable magnification, error correction, and structured append.

Reference parameters: **a, b, c, d, e, f, g**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 124](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
